checks.name: Home is a scope-first evidence dashboard, with actual evidence counts
All eleven result pages render complete claim sections and correct identities
New and legacy routes coexist; unknown IDs recover
Every plotted value is finite, labeled, and links a shipped CSV
Plot inputs match CSV values, retaining failed coarse results and source-center differences
Result search and evidence filter have recoverable empty states
Theory search maintains typed edges and explicitly avoids implication reversal
Technical mode survives denied storage and preserves the selected result
New document popups use the existing escaped, explicit-open dialog
External links reject unsafe schemes, protocol-relative paths and credentials
Missing/invalid plot evidence is displayed as unavailable
Independent source and claim metadata are present, without numerical evidence becoming a theorem

scope: Render, event-handler and evidence binding checks using a minimal DOM stand-in; no browser layout or end-to-end certification.
